text: Varen, Sept. 14 — Northwind Regional will open a maintenance and operations hub at Castellane Airfield next spring, according to people familiar with the matter. The carrier plans to base 18 turboprops and 260 staff at the site, using the facility as a connector for short-haul routes across the Glaive coast and the inland lake district. The hub will include a new dispatch center, light cargo handling and a training hangar, said the people, who asked not to be identified because the plan is not public. Castellane’s operator has already begun runway lighting upgrades and apron work valued at 41 million crowns, the people said. Northwind is expected to announce the move formally later this month.
